  \typeout{PT-TEST-MODULES=\ptiflayoutloaded{1}{0}\ptifcontentloaded{1}{0}\ptifruntimeloaded{1}{0}}%

  \typeout{PT-TEST-LANGUAGE=\languagename}%
}
\makeatother
